nodes.label: Go Modular Monolith
nodes.rationale: Keeps early implementation and operations simple while preserving module boundaries until concrete scaling or ownership needs justify service extraction.

nodes.label: Elapsed Time as Common Axis
nodes.rationale: Chat, metrics, candidate intervals, and alternate viewpoints can be connected consistently when normalized to elapsed time from video start.

nodes.label: Synchronous M1 Metadata Acquisition
nodes.rationale: M1 needs immediate preview of lightweight videos.list metadata, while introducing background job infrastructure would exceed the milestone's scope.

nodes.label: ADR-0002 M2 Background Collection Job Model
Background Collection Job Model
nodes.rationale: Long-running chat collection must survive closed browser sessions, process restarts, multiple workers, and retries without direct RPC or an in-memory queue.

nodes.label: ADR-0003 M3 Multi-step Collection and Sync
Job and Step State Aggregation
nodes.rationale: A user collection request needs an aggregate status while each acquisition step can independently succeed, fail, report no data, and be retried.

nodes.label: Reservation and Collection Responsibility Boundary
nodes.rationale: Separating long-lived monitoring from collection execution distinguishes monitoring failures from collection failures and prevents duplicated job state.

nodes.label: Independent YouTube Data Gateway Service
nodes.rationale: An independent service isolates unstable YouTube response formats, credential handling, and acquisition libraries from worker job management and persistence.

nodes.label: ADR-0005 Discontinue Media and Transcript Collection
Media and Transcript Collection Discontinuation
nodes.rationale: Transcript and server-side media handling add cross-layer acquisition, storage, and analysis cost disproportionate to the current value of clip-candidate discovery.

nodes.label: User-visible Vertical Slice Milestones
nodes.rationale: Each milestone must deliver an independently operable user workflow across UI, API, persistence or processing, and result display rather than only infrastructure.

nodes.label: Phase 1 Archive Collection and Synchronized Viewing
Secret Management
nodes.rationale: Secrets and production connection strings stay out of version control, while committed examples remain clearly non-secret.

nodes.label: Dependency-ordered Implementation Planning
nodes.rationale: A reviewed plan translates user-visible milestone scope into dependency-ordered issues without allowing individual issues to expand that scope.

nodes.label: Media and Transcript Collection Removal Plan
Incremental Media and Transcript Removal Rollout
nodes.rationale: Removing job generation and readers before schema deletion keeps each commit verifiable and avoids deployed code referencing removed tables.

Contracts Database Tests and Docs Layout
